corpus.inclusion: Distinct work with exact v1, valid v1 event inside accepted six UTC months, in frozen current cs.SE query; all nonmatches included
corpus.population: Observed frozen 2026 current cs.SE query; not historically complete cs.SE

product_pending.E8: Measure bounded wall time and peak process memory on recorded reviewer environment

exposure.prospective_only: Freeze unchanged replay and future disclosed reviewer tasks, not untouched scientific validation
exposure.statement: All 598 development metadata, bins, counts/shares, sensitivities and nine late-ID cases inspected before this freeze. Local declaration and post-output metadata correction preserved. No rule/value change.

future_evaluation.authorization: Separate owner approval required before acquisition
future_evaluation.overlap: Reconcile exact work AND version identity against all 598, 27 pilot and nine late IDs; quarantine overlap; record prior source-evidence exposure

immutability.anchor: Manifest SHA256 recorded outside manifest in receipt and G70; new bundle commit recorded externally to avoid self-hash cycle
immutability.policy: Never edit this version or old development evidence. New version explicitly supersedes with reason, exposure and external approval/digest.
reopen: Owner requires historical-as-of or scientific detection quality
immutability.source_split: research_source entries verified against exact source commit; freeze_support entries are newly created and pinned by manifest, then bundle commit

owner_approval.G70: Conditional on verified F1 and all accepted research criteria; not automatic

reviewers.author: Codex producing agent; same-host verification, not independent human
reviewers.future_task: Five correct answers: n/N, share, 2026 observed vs 2019 event, lexical vs semantic, no trend/as-of inference; open match/nonmatch; replay without code edits; preserve raw answers/failures; disclose retest exposure
reviewers.reviewer_exposure: UNASSIGNED; disclose identity, prior exposure and environment before product task
reviewers.simulation: SIMULATED_A/B/C on SYN-001..SYN-027; 54 judgments, 18 agreements, 9 adjudications, final 9/9/9 are designed fixtures

runtime.method: Sorted [relative POSIX path,SHA256] compact UTF-8 JSON over Lib and DLLs .py/.pyd/.dll/.zip; exclude site-packages and __pycache__; root .exe/.dll separately. OS, caches and system DLLs are not hermetically frozen.

runtime_scope.dependencies: Python standard library; Git for object verification; no new package
runtime_scope.evaluation: Author same-host offline integrity/replay verification. Not independent reviewer replay or a hermetic OS image.
runtime_scope.new_reviewer_runtime: Before a new product evaluation, append a separately versioned runtime/task/personnel record; do not mutate this author inventory.

sensitivities: exclude nine late IDs as perturbation only

signal.formula: N=eligible distinct works; n=sum of title-rule matches; p=n/N if defined. Aggregate windows use ratio of sums.
signal.labels: NONE at every support value; no growth/emergence/decline or scientific relevance claim
signal.null_policy: Unknown/invalid title stays in N; n/p=null; retain known-match count and bounds. Invalid event makes monthly N unresolved. Empty N makes share null.
signal.support: n>=0; defined share needs N>=1 and known required fields; not a statistical-adequacy threshold

temporal.distinct_times: Acquisition, v1 submission, version update and public availability must never be conflated

verification_commands: Historical run_checks.py validates original PROPOSED status docs: run against source commit export. New accepted decision state is verified separately.
